---
title: "LLMs & IA Agentique pour les PMs"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: custom
    self-contained: false
---

```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;700;900&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #030712;
      --text: #F8FAFC;
      --muted: #94A3B8;
      --violet: #8B5CF6;
      --cyan: #06B6D4;
      --emerald: #10B981;
      --glow-v: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.25);
      --glow-c: rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.2);
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      background: var(--bg);
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      color: var(--text);
    }

    /* Abstract Background Shapes */
    .bg-shapes {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    
    .shape {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(80px);
      animation: float 20s infinite ease-in-out alternate;
    }

    .shape-1 {
      top: -10%; left: 10%; width: 40vw; height: 40vw;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--glow-v), transparent 70%);
      animation-delay: 0s;
    }
    .shape-2 {
      bottom: -10%; right: 10%; width: 50vw; height: 50vw;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--glow-c), transparent 70%);
      animation-delay: -5s;
    }
    .shape-3 {
      top: 40%; left: 40%; width: 30vw; height: 30vw;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(16,185,129,0.1), transparent 70%);
      animation-delay: -10s;
    }

    /* Subtle Grid Overlay */
    .grid-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: 
        linear-gradient(to right, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 40px 40px;
      mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, black 30%, transparent 80%);
      -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, black 30%, transparent 80%);
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* Top Navigation */
    .top-nav {
      position: absolute;
      top: 1.5rem;
      right: 2rem;
      z-index: 50;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.1s both;
    }

    .lang-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.5em 1.2em;
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 20px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
      backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
      transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .lang-btn:hover {
      color: var(--text);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }

    .lang-btn .arr { font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1; }

    /* Main Container */
    .container {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 10;
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 900px;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 1rem 2rem;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
    }

    /* Badge */
    .badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--cyan);
      border: 1px solid rgba(6,182,212,0.3);
      border-radius: 30px;
      padding: 0.4em 1.2em;
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      background: rgba(6,182,212,0.05);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.2s both;
    }

    .badge span { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--cyan); box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--cyan); animation: pulse 2s infinite; }

    /* Typography */
    h1 {
      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1.1;
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #A5B4FC 50%, #8B5CF6 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.4s both;
    }

    .subtitle {
      font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.2rem);
      font-weight: 400;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
      max-width: 650px;
      margin: 0 auto 2.5rem auto;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.6s both;
    }

    .subtitle strong {
      color: #E2E8F0;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Conceptual Diagram */
    .hero-diagram {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.8s both;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .hd-node {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 1rem 2rem;
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
    }

    .hd-node:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }

    .hd-node.center {
      border-color: var(--violet);
      box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(139,92,246,0.2), inset 0 0 20px rgba(139,92,246,0.1);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(139,92,246,0.1) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%);
    }

    .hd-icon { font-size: 2rem; }
    .hd-text { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.1rem; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: #fff; }

    .hd-arrow {
      height: 2px;
      width: 50px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.1), rgba(255,255,255,0.5), rgba(255,255,255,0.1));
      position: relative;
    }

    .hd-arrow::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      right: 0; top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      width: 0; height: 0;
      border-top: 4px solid transparent;
      border-bottom: 4px solid transparent;
      border-left: 6px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    }

    .hd-arrow .light {
      position: absolute;
      top: -1px; left: 0;
      width: 20px; height: 4px;
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 4px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px #fff;
      animation: shoot 2s infinite;
    }

    /* CTA Button */
    .cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.2rem;
      padding: 1rem 2.5rem;
      border-radius: 40px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: #fff;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 1s both;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    .cta::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.1), transparent);
      transform: translateX(-100%);
      transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    }

    .cta:hover {
      transform: scale(1.03) translateY(-3px);
      border-color: var(--cyan);
      box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(6,182,212,0.25);
      background: rgba(6,182,212,0.1);
    }

    .cta:hover::before {
      transform: translateX(100%);
    }

    .cta-icon {
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      background: #fff;
      color: var(--bg);
      width: 38px; height: 38px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 50%;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .cta:hover .cta-icon {
      transform: translateX(4px);
    }

    .cta-text {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      text-align: left;
    }

    .cta-text .main { font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 1.2;}
    .cta-text .sub { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 0.2rem;}

    /* Footer Elements */
    .footer-tags {
      display: flex;
      gap: 1.5rem;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-top: 3rem;
      animation: fadeUp 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 1.2s both;
    }

    .ft-item {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
    }

    .ft-item::before {
      content: '';
      display: inline-block;
      width: 5px; height: 5px;
      background: var(--muted);
      border-radius: 50%;
      opacity: 0.5;
    }

    /* Keyframes */
    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(35px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    @keyframes float {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
      100% { transform: translate(40px, -60px) scale(1.15); }
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50% { opacity: 0.3; }
    }
    @keyframes shoot {
      0% { left: 0; opacity: 0; }
      10% { opacity: 1; }
      90% { opacity: 1; }
      100% { left: 100%; opacity: 0; }
    }

    /* Responsive */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .hero-diagram { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }
      .hd-arrow { width: 2px; height: 40px; }
      .hd-arrow::after { right: 50%; top: 100%; transform: translate(50%, 0); border-left: 5px solid transparent; border-right: 5px solid transparent; border-top: 7px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); border-bottom: none; }
      .hd-arrow .light { top: 0; left: -1px; width: 4px; height: 20px; animation: shootV 2s infinite; }
      .footer-tags { flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; }
    }
    @keyframes shootV { 0% { top: 0; opacity: 0; } 10% { opacity: 1; } 90% { opacity: 1; } 100% { top: 100%; opacity: 0; } }

  </style>
</head>
<body>

  <nav class="top-nav">
    <a href="#" class="lang-btn">English version <span class="arr">↗</span></a>
  </nav>

  <div class="bg-shapes">
    <div class="shape shape-1"></div>
    <div class="shape shape-2"></div>
    <div class="shape shape-3"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="grid-overlay"></div>

  <div class="container">
    
    <div class="badge">
      <span></span> Masterclass Product
    </div>

    <h1>Des Prompts aux Produits.</h1>

    <p class="subtitle">
      Une plongée immersive dans l'architecture des <strong>Large Language Models</strong> et le basculement vers l'<strong>Intelligence Agentique</strong>. Conçu pour les PMs, POs et praticiens de la data.
    </p>

    <div class="hero-diagram">
      <div class="hd-node">
        <span class="hd-icon">🧠</span>
        <span class="hd-text">LLM CORE</span>
      </div>
      <div class="hd-arrow"><div class="light"></div></div>
      <div class="hd-node center">
        <span class="hd-icon">🤖</span>
        <span class="hd-text">AGENT</span>
      </div>
      <div class="hd-arrow"><div class="light"></div></div>
      <div class="hd-node">
        <span class="hd-icon">⚡</span>
        <span class="hd-text">ACTIONS</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <a href="fr.html" class="cta">
      <div class="cta-text">
        <span class="main">Lancer l'expérience</span>
        <span class="sub">Présentation interactive · ~45 min</span>
      </div>
      <div class="cta-icon">→</div>
    </a>

    <div class="footer-tags">
      <div class="ft-item">Act I · Intelligence</div>
      <div class="ft-item">Act II · Autonomie</div>
      <div class="ft-item">Act III · Orchestration</div>
    </div>

  </div>

</body>
</html>
```
